description: The bar chart, titled “Marco-o1-7B,” visually compares the inference time (in minutes) across five different methods—Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, and O1-Pruner—across two separate experimental setups or datasets, displayed side by side. On the left chart, the inference times range from approximately 1.1 minutes (O1-Pruner, blue) to 2.2 minutes (Baseline, light green), with Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow) at ~2.1, SFT (gray) at ~2.0, and DPO (orange) at ~1.5. On the right chart, inference times are longer overall, ranging from ~3.9 minutes (O1-Pruner, blue) to ~6.1 minutes (Baseline, light green), with Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow) at ~5.0, SFT (gray) at ~5.8, and DPO (orange) at ~5.5. Both charts use a horizontal bar layout with the same color-coded legend at the bottom, and the x-axis represents inference time in minutes with tick marks at 0.5-minute intervals up to 7 minutes. The O1-Pruner consistently shows the shortest inference time in both charts, suggesting improved efficiency, while the Baseline consistently shows the longest. The charts are ungrouped, with each method represented by a single bar per chart, and no error bars or statistical annotations are present. The right chart also includes a gray rectangular placeholder at the top, possibly indicating a missing or reserved label or title.
